script_hooks.logic:
Let enemyContainer be the enemy group.
Let helper be given (arg1, arg2) { If arg2 meets the move condition {canHookOfReceivedDamageOrHeal: true} and arg2's 'receiver' has the WATER_BALL status and not (arg2 meets the damage condition {ability: {reasonStatusAilmentId: the WATER_BALL status}}), then { If arg2's 'damage' is at least 0, then return 0. Otherwise, return -1. } Otherwise, return arg2's 'damage'. }.
Hook (helper tied to this state) into enemyContainer's 'aiHook' as the ADJUST_DAMAGE hook named "adjustDamageReceive".
Let helper2 be given (arg) { If every member in the living party where member has the WATER_BALL status, then return game:Conf.JUDGE.LOSE. Otherwise, return arg. }.
Hook (helper2 tied to this state) into enemyContainer's 'aiHook' as the JUDGE_VICTORY hook named "judgeVictory".
